description: Build options: the --switches every UI build accepts, whatever drives it (CLI `axf init --<flag>`, `axf options`, engine-rpc, `axf serve` HTTP, the console API/UI and the console MCP). Each option writes a token into the app's assets, so the engines (both ports) read it like any other token. New options are added here only; every driver reads this file. Values: --flag (on), --flag on|off|true|false, --no-flag (off).

wrap-groups.label: Wrap groups
wrap-groups.description: Every section / group (Container) gets a small collapse toggle in its top-right corner, e.g. Role, Access policy and Console token in Settings.
